messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD: PD 57AD disclosure two years on — 16 April
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

Join us for a lunchtime CPD session, 'PD 57AD Disclosure Two Years On: Practical Lessons', on 16 April at 12:30 in the Bishopsgate training room (lunch provided). 1 hour CPD. Register via the L&D portal.

Best wishes,
Knowledge & Learning Team
